newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian Air boosts Latam cargo operations.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Air boosts Latam cargo operations.

text.p: Canadian Airlines International said it has begun direct five-times-weekly DC-10 services to Buenos Aires as an extension of its Toronto-Sao Paolo route.

For Canadian's cargo division, it marks a return to the Argentine capital after a five-year absence. Parent CAI has been serving Buenos Aires as a passenger-only code-share basis with Varig Brazilian Airlines on the latter's flights.

Besides carrying freight from Canada to Brazil and Argentina, the airline will be able to carry cargo between the two South American countries, said John Gibson, general manager international marketing.
Canadian Air Cargo also announced it has expanded its code-sharing programme with American Airlines to include additional joint flights between Dallas/Fort Worth and Canada.
Canadian now offers two round-trips between Vancouver and D/FW and one between Toronto and D/FW, one of 16 U.S. destinations it serves.
